notes:
POC started promising but now stalled. Quick summary:
- Customer: mid-size adtech DSP, heavy personalization + reranking load. Wanted lower-latency model routing between private/dedicated variants.
- POC scope: validate dedicated pool in VPC, test prefix cache for user session embeddings, verify routing fallback.
- What we delivered: infra spun in their VPC, small model pinned, latency tests good, embedding accuracy baseline established.
- What broke: they missed milestone 3 (end-to-end integration) — engineering cycles frozen for Q1 due to re-org and budget re-prioritization.
- Security asked for clear data residency statement and HSM/KMS workflow. SEC team raised ticket SEC-3890; they want on-prem option for certain PII flows.
- Sales signals: "we love the perf but can't commit until budget unfreeze"; internal champion (VP Product) left Feb 2026.
- Competitive pressure: Anthropic partner offered to run a free extended trial and provided a temporary credit line — procurement leaning that way.
- Finance: expected ARR $150-400k, but procurement placed a hold — likely delay to next quarter or close-lost.
- SE notes: Priya - "POC technically healthy, risk > org/finance than product".
- Recommended actions: engage new product sponsor, offer a 30-day technical rescue (light-engage SE hours), deliver a focused security pack (residency + KMS diagram), or propose formal close-out and keep warm.
- Customer tone: polite but detached; low responsiveness to emails since Feb 12.
- Quote from CTO on 2026-02-10 call: "We're not pulling the plug on tech, it's purely timing — no cycles right now."
- Risk: high. Likely outcome = stalemate or closed-lost to competitor if budget not released by May.
next_steps_detail:
- 1) Schedule 30-min sync with procurement + new product lead (target week of 2026-03-08).
- 2) Draft short security pack (KMS + residency + audit logs) and hand to SEC-3890 owner.
- 3) Offer a 2-week SE rescue to finish milestone 3 at reduced rate.
- 4) If unresponsive by 2026-03-22, convert to closed-lost and record competitive feedback.
loss_rationale: Primary: no engineering capacity (roadmap freeze) + procurement budget hold. Secondary: security/residency concerns and competitor offering temporary trial credits. Internal champion departure accelerated stall.
